text:
Grace CSM: Kicking off Verdant Labs onboarding — first sync next Tue 10am PT. cc @Noah Implementation and @Ivy SE. Agenda draft: 1) success criteria 2) timelines & milestones 3) stakeholders & access 4) enablement plan 5) risks. link: https://drive.redwood/verdant/onboard-agenda :spiral_calendar:
Noah Implementation: Tue 10am works for me. I can take lead on environment setup and initial runbook.
Ivy SE: I'll cover integrations and demo flow. Can we reserve 30m for a hands-on session with their ML infra team?
Raj Sales: FYI procurement asked for SSO + SOC2 docs before contract signature — may impact timelines. I'll push to get those by EOW but flagging as renewal risk if delayed.
Grace CSM: Good point Raj. Success criteria proposal: 1) API integrated in sandbox 2) 1 feature live behind feature flag 3) 7-day P95 latency < 600ms on test load 4) team trained on rollback/playbooks. Thoughts?
Olga PM: Add "observability configured" (basic dashboards + alerting) to success criteria — important for their ops team.
Noah Implementation: For timeline, propose: Week 0: account + SSO access; Week 1: sandbox integration + demo; Week 2: feature flag pilot; Week 3: go/no-go. If procurement slips, we can parallelize some enablement work.
Ivy SE: Can we get DB creds and a staging model snapshot before Tue? If not, demo will be limited.
Grace CSM: Action items: - Raj: chase SOC2 + SSO docs (ETA Fri) - Noah: internal runbook + infra checklist (ETA Mon) - Ivy: demo script + pre-reqs doc (ETA Mon) - Olga: observability template to share (ETA Mon)
Raj Sales: On it — pinging procurement now. @Grace any escalation channel if they stall?
Grace CSM: Yes escalate to me and cc @CEO if >48h stall. Also adding a short intake form for Verdant to fill so we can collect contacts, SLAs, and any compliance needs: https://forms.redwood/verdant-intake
CalendarBot: Event created: "Verdant Labs Onboarding Kickoff" 2026-04-14 10:00 PT (invite sent)
Noah Implementation: I'll drop a quick runbook snippet here before EOD: ```Checklist:\n- VPC/IP allowlist\n- API key generation\n- Sample payloads\n- KV cache config```
Ivy SE: OK I'll target a 15min hands-on in the kickoff for live request/response. If creds aren't ready we can use recorded traces.
Grace CSM: Thanks team. One more: please add any customer concerns to this thread so I capture them for the kickoff notes.
Raj Sales: Verdant asked about data retention and encryption-at-rest — I'll add to the intake form.
Olga PM: Noted. I'll prepare a 10-slide enablement deck focused on rollback, monitoring, and cost controls.
Grace CSM: Perfect. I'll compile everything into the kickoff deck and share by Mon 9am PT. :thumbsup:
